name: Korabl'-Sputnik-3
about: Korabl'-Sputnik-3 (1960 RHO 1), a crewed vehicle (Vostok1), launched 1960 Dec  1. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (D).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1960 Dec  1), held fixed
